description: Federated threat-intelligence service: query a known-bad IP database and return verdict, confidence, and source attribution. Part of the IETF_Vienna DNS-AID demo federation.
instructions: Send tools/call with name=lookup_ip and arguments.ip=<IPv4 string>. Returns {verdict: clean|malicious|unknown, confidence: 0.0-1.0, sources: [string], tags: [string]}.

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Return federation reputation verdict for an IPv4 address.
